habitat: Temperate forests; subtropical/tropical moist montane forests; mixed forest; and forest edge
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Chinese Thrush (Turdus mupinensis) stands out. This species, part of the Turdidae family, is a resident of Temperate forests; subtropical/tropical moist montane forests; mixed forest; and forest edge. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Chinese Thrush is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Chinese Thrush and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
